title: Longest Common Prefix
summary: Return the longest prefix shared by every string in the array, or "".

title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
summary: Build a Trie with insert(word), search(word) (exact match) and startsWith(prefix).

perf.label: 30,000 inserts and 60,000 queries
perf.call: Trie t = new Trie(); long sum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 30000; i++) t.insert(BCB.str(BCB.rnd(5, 20), "abcde")); for (int i = 0; i < 30000; i++) { if (t.search(BCB.str(BCB.rnd(1, 10), "abcde"))) sum++; if (t.startsWith(BCB.str(BCB.rnd(1, 8), "abcde"))) sum += 2; } Object r = sum;

title: Design Add and Search Words Data Structure
summary: WordDictionary supports addWord(word) and search(word), where "." in the search word matches any single letter.

perf.label: 20,000 words and 20,000 wildcard searches
perf.call: WordDictionary d = new WordDictionary(); long sum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 20000; i++) d.addWord(BCB.str(BCB.rnd(3, 10), "abcd")); for (int i = 0; i < 20000; i++) { char[] w = BCB.str(BCB.rnd(3, 10), "abcd").toCharArray(); w[0] = '.'; if (d.search(new String(w))) sum++; } Object r = sum;

title: Replace Words
summary: Replace every word in the sentence that starts with a dictionary root by the shortest such root, and return the sentence.

in: "the cattle was rattled by the battery"
tests.out: "the cat was rat by the bat"

perf.label: 1,000 roots and a 100,000-word sentence
perf.gen: List<String> a0 = new ArrayList<>(); for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) a0.add(BCB.str(BCB.rnd(1, 5), "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz")); StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(); for (int i = 0; i < 100000; i++) { if (i > 0) sb.append(' '); sb.append(BCB.str(BCB.rnd(3, 10), "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz")); } String a1 = sb.toString();

perf.label: n = 200,000

title: Word Search II
summary: Return every word from the list that can be traced on the letter grid through horizontally or vertically adjacent cells, using each cell at most once per word. Any order.
